history.summary: A new-launch freehold 3BR at The Hillshore (Fraxtor/FRX, 59 units, TOP Q2 2027) in Pasir Panjang D05, 460m to Haw Par Villa MRT with GSW upside. Strong arena showing, but a tiny 59-unit boutique with new-launch developer pricing ($2,358 PSF), no appreciation data (7 txns) and a $2.49M 3BR makes the exit risk too high for a confident buy.
history.rating_rationale: Confirmed via search: 59-unit boutique freehold by Fraxtor Capital (ex-Gloria Mansion en-bloc), TOP Q2 2027, GSW-adjacent. Positives: 460m (6 min) to CC25 Haw Par Villa, Greater Southern Waterfront catalyst, freehold, on_frontier with a strong 341-227 arena record. Negatives are structural: only 59 units = thin resale liquidity; new_launch_bias=true with no usable appreciation rate (7 txns); $2,358 PSF and a $2.49M absolute price for a 1,055 sqft 3BR is developer-launch pricing where the early premium is paid by the buyer, not earned. Boutique illiquidity + launch pricing cap a 5-7yr investment case.
red_flags: 59-unit boutique — shallow resale liquidity / limited amenities
new-launch developer pricing, no usable appreciation data (7 txns, bias=true)
